content:
I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
unloaded_plate_coupon:
- the roof over the pocket: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.
:
- the clamp: I can't tell you how that one came out.
- the bolt's head: I can't tell you how that one came out.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

I’ll flip the coupon’s print orientation so the bolt-head pocket opens upward. That removes the pocket-roof bridge that produced the loops, while keeping the same test geometry.

It remains an **unloaded fit-test only**: the clamp fit and bolt seating are still unverified. Don’t attach the camera.

Not approved camera engagement."}},"parts":[{"id":"unloaded_plate_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"def build(p):
    w = p.plate_nominal_width - p.base_width_allowance
    t = w - 2*p.trial_side_inset
    h = p.trial_dovetail_height
    H = p.coupon_total_height
    L = p.coupon_length
    # Camera deck at z=0; wide clamp-side face at z=H.
    # The dovetail expands outward at 45 degrees near the top.
    profile = [(-t/2,0),(t/2,0),(t/2,H-h),(w/2,H),(-w/2,H),(-t/2,H-h)]
    body = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(L/2, both=True)
    bore = cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.camera_thread_d+p.bolt_hole_diametral_clearance)/2).extrude(H)
    pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-p.head_pocket_depth).circle((p.bolt_head_d+p.head_pocket_diametral_clearance)/2).extrude(p.head_pocket_depth)
    return body.cut(bore).cut(pocket)

Keep the supplied orientation: narrow flat deck on bed, large pocket opening UP. Disable supports; no pocket-roof bridge is present. Preview layers to confirm the pocket stays open upward. The outer dovetail grows outward at 45 degrees.","parts":["unloaded_plate_coupon"],"tool":"Slicer"},{"n":"3","text":"Print and let cool. Remove any brim, bore strings, and bed-edge flare without changing the sloped clamping faces. Check the pocket floor is sound. If the through hole is obstructed or the floor is defective, stop and report the defect rather than forcing the bolt.","parts":["unloaded_plate_coupon"],"tool":"Deburring tool"},{"n":"4","text":"On the bench, insert the metal webcam bolt through the large pocket toward the narrow deck. Verify free passage, flat bearing contact, head containment, and access with its original drive. Measure actual tip projection above the deck; nominally 3 mm. Do not thread it into the camera. Remove the bolt before clamp testing.","parts":["unloaded_plate_coupon"],"hardware":["camera_bolt"],"tool":"Calipers and original bolt driver if applicable"},{"n":"5","text":"With no camera or bolt attached, flip the coupon so its wide face is down. Gently drop into the open tripod jaws, with the long axis along them. Tighten only by hand. Stop for rocking, edge-only contact, bottoming, deck interference, or excessive force. Do not modify or overtighten the borrowed tripod.","parts":["unloaded_plate_coupon"]},{"n":"6","text":"With hands ready to catch the unloaded coupon, gently check for lifting and sliding. Remove it afterward. Report clamp contact and bolt-head results if possible; neither is currently known. Even a successful fit does not establish safe camera support.","parts":["unloaded_plate_coupon"]},{"n":"7","text":"Do not attach a camera or ballast. A final load-bearing design requires the missing jaw geometry, stop arrangement, bolt details, and verified safe thread engagement. Until then, use a metal replacement plate matched to the tripod rather than this coupon.","parts":["unloaded_plate_coupon"]}]}
